study type: Simulation study evaluating epidemiologic designs (time-stratified case-crossover, time-series, pair-matched case-control, and time-to-event)
cohort: The study generated pseudo-birth data based on observed seasonal patterns of birth in the United States.
finding: Most epidemiologic designs can be implemented in a way that yields estimates unbiased by conception seasonality, though the time-stratified case-crossover design exhibited a small positive bias which could be corrected.
gest_age: The study focused on preterm births, which are defined by gestational age.
